own_solution.law: Constructive interference gives d sin(theta) = m lambda. Using the stated small-angle approximation, y = m lambda D/d. Thus y = 3(600e-9)(2)/(0.3e-3) = 0.012 m = 12 mm.
assumptions: The slits receive coherent illumination from the incident light.
The screen has the usual transverse orientation.
The camera does not obstruct or disturb the interference apparatus.

notes: The relevant screen shifts of 35, 70 and 150 cm produce distances of 2.35, 2.70 and 3.50 m and fringe positions of 14.1, 16.2 and 21.0 mm, respectively. Every disconnected variant retains 12.0 mm. Lengths must be converted to compatible units when evaluating the symbolic relations; all certified results use the stated target unit of mm. The declared minimal pairs TE2C3/T3468 and TC70F/T55CC preserve the number and unit while changing the event or object attachment. I withdraw the pass-1 rendering_not_minimal flag because pass 2 explicitly identifies T1277 and T68D0 as numeral-free controls, rather than numbered minimal pairs. Their wording matches their numerical twins after replacing the numerical distance. The physical solution and all pass-1 stratum assignments remain unchanged.
